_comment: SECOND-BRAIN memory wiring. MERGE these keys into the project's committed .claude/settings.json, then delete this _comment key. Do NOT clobber existing env or hooks entries; add to them (a project may already have a PreToolUse guard hook, etc.). Replace <BRAIN_MCP_ORIGIN> with the shared server origin (for Mike's live server: https://second-brain.rihm.workers.dev) and <PROJECT_ID> with this project's id. The BRAIN_MCP_TOKEN secret does NOT belong here; it goes in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json (see the setup recipe, 'mint local token' step).

env.GRAPH_BACKEND: <local|cloud|hybrid — only if the structural layer is installed; the owner's storage answer, usually local>
